body:
Closes #709

## Summary
- accept only finite, non-boolean numeric ratings before computing the Rocchio median and centroids
- keep invalid ratings out of support, IDF, and learned preference weights
- cover NaN, both infinities, booleans, text, and remaining valid high/low scores

## Tasks
- [x] Filter non-finite and boolean ratings in build()
- [x] Add a regression proving valid ratings still produce a non-empty preference vector

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Focused Rocchio tests pass (13 passed)
- [x] Full repository suite passes (2,046 passed, 12 skipped; 87.64% coverage)
- [x] Deliberate removal of the finiteness guard makes the named regression fail; restoration passes
- [x] Ruff, Black, strict source mypy, and git diff check pass

## Validation
- /opt/anaconda3/bin/python -m pytest -q
- /opt/anaconda3/bin/ruff check src/fine_art_archive/preference/rocchio.py tests/test_rocchio_preference.py
- /opt/anaconda3/bin/black --check src/fine_art_archive/preference/rocchio.py tests/test_rocchio_preference.py
- /opt/anaconda3/bin/mypy --strict src/fine_art_archive/preference/rocchio.py
- git diff --check
